positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Optimized a recursive React Fiber tree traversal algorithm in order to accurately capture memoizedState for all stateful Fiber Nodes and enable time travel state debugging

• Used Acorn-JSX to parse React functional components’ JSX, generating an abstract syntax tree suitable to traverse in order to locate and store all declared useState hook variables 

• Designed Next.js, React Concurrent Mode / Suspense, and Context API testing sandboxes served by Node.js / Express to ensure the timeline of state snapshots is recorded correctly

• Defined Typescript interfaces and types necessary for static type checking and IntelliSense
alerts, accelerating team workflows by simplifying debugging and enhancing scalability

• Developed Jest and Puppeteer tests that enable accelerated team development cycles by preventing compatibility regression as new product features are built and deployed

• Leveraged D3.js for an interactive state timeline visualization by using its modules to
compute SVG path attributes enabling React to render dynamic vector shapes to the DOM

• Standardized the Travis CI / Github continuous integration workflow to automatically run
unit and end-to-end tests to prevent bugs from being introduced into production code

• Reactime has been nominated for the Productivity Booster award at React Open Source Awards 2020 in Amsterdam

positions.title: Founder and Lead Engineer
positions.description:
• Launched two event discovery platforms with a talented team of 3 veterans of NYC’s tech startup community

• Designed Adobe XD / Sketch wireframes and prototypes to create intuitive user experiences
before devising application architecture, writing code, and iterating based on user feedback

• Employed React and React Router while building modularized SPAs leveraging dynamic re-rendering and unidirectional data flow to ensure code maintainability and extensibility

• Implemented Ruby on Rails REST API models, HAML views, controllers, and serializers to
dynamically query a PostgreSQL database and retrieve data requested via URL slugs

• Incorporated JWTs and Bcrypt’s one-way hashing algorithm to secure routes and API
endpoints with a login system that is protected against intruders and rainbow table attacks

• Crafted an interactive React Native UI animation with variable states corresponding to the user’s touch position and movement in order to create an engaging user micro-interaction

positions.title: Aviation Consulting Analyst
positions.description:
• Performed market analysis and crafted strategies for diverse airline, airport, and transportation authority clients in North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Africa, the Middle East, and Asia 

• Wrote and executed SQL queries to retrieve and manipulate relational data used for
financial data modeling and decision making as well as supply and demand forecasting

• Designed PowerPoint presentations while employing Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for custom graphics and vector drawings

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: • Collected, interpreted, and summarized data in support of Healthcare Administration program manuscripts, projects, and presentations

positions.title: Aviation Consulting Intern
positions.description:
• Identified high-growth opportunities for an aeronautical school desiring to expand internationally

• Led a Microsoft Access project that leveraged relational database capabilities to create an efficiency-enhancing tool for handling ICF’s intellectual property

• Performed in-depth research and analysis in support of two due diligence projects for aircraft repair companies (MRO)

• Supported timely completion of projects requiring data modeling, forecasting, and PowerPoint design skills

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: • Managed up to 62 diverse students and built a positive living environment through active student engagement

positions.title: Product Management Intern
positions.description:
• Resolved data errors for 15,000+ SKUs to allow for accurate analysis of product attach rates

• Led a cross-functional team that produced universal standards which reduced product development costs

• Improved marketing and public perception by creating and updating 30+ web pages, 6 product guides, and 3 marketing bulletins leveraging best practices for effective external communication

• Assisted in constructing the Quarterly Business Review report by analyzing data and performance models

positions.title: Graduate of Marine Corps Officer Candidate School Platoon Leaders Class (PLC) Juniors
positions.description:
• Led teams of 4-50 members through exceptionally stressful environments and problem-solving scenarios

• Aviation Selection Test Battery (ASTB) score: 7/9/8 (Top 3% of pilot candidates)
